page.layout: Top: two round medallion portraits side by side, with legends, not text. Below them one column of text in two paragraphs. Below the text: a decorative tailpiece ornament, no text. Running head at top centre; page number at top right.

main_text.l: L. OTHO, Imperatoris Othonis pater, materno genere
charus,támq; non absimilis facie Tiberio principi fuit,ut pleri-
que procreatū ex eo crederent.Hic urbanos honores,Procon-
sulatum Africæ,& extraordinaria imperia seuerissimè admini-
strauit. Senatus hunc honore rarissimo,statua in palatio posita,
prosecutus est: & Claudius allectum inter Patricios collaudās
hunc amplissimis verbis,hæc quoq; adiecit:Vir,quo meliores libe-
ros habere ne opto quidem. Sueton.in Othone.
fuit,quæ peperit illi L. Titianum,siue Terentianū,& minorem
Galbam imperavit:peperit quoq; filiam, quam nondum nubi-
lem Drufo Germanici filio despōdit, Consulito Suetonium in Othone.

page.notes: The two medallions carry engraved legends (left: L. SILVIVS OTHO ... IMP. PATER; right: ALBIA TERENTIA OTHO IMP. ...); these are illustrations, not running text, and are not transcribed. Tailpiece ornament at the foot is not text.
